div.div: سِلْبٌ The longest [thing] of the apparatus of the plough: (AHn, M, K:) or a piece of wood that is joined to the base of the لُؤْمَة [here meaning ploughshare], its end being [inserted] in the hole, or perforation, of the latter. (M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
